chunks: Humayd, from Al-Hasan, from Ja'far ibn Sama'ah, from Dawud ibn Sirhan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding the woman who gives Khul'a (mutual divorce), he said: Her waiting period is the waiting period of the divorced woman, and she waits in her house, and the woman who gives Khul'a is in the status of the woman who gives Mubara'ah.

key_terms.الْمُبَارِئَةِ: The woman who initiates Mubara'ah (mutual release/divorce)
key_terms.الْمُخْتَلِعَةِ: The woman who initiates Khul'a (divorce by mutual consent where the wife pays compensation)
key_terms.فِي بَيْتِهَا: In her house (residence during waiting period)

ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period and legal status of a woman who initiates a Khul'a divorce in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the Iddah of a woman initiating Khul'a mirrors that of a standard divorce, requiring her to remain in her marital home, thereby distinguishing it from the mutual release of Mubara'ah. This ruling underscores the jurisprudential nuance in Shia fiqh where Khul'a, despite being initiated by the wife, retains the structural legal framework of a revocable divorce regarding residence and waiting period. The hadith highlights the practical implications for financial support and housing during this transitional phase.

en.hubeali:
Humeyd, from Al Hassan, from Ja’far Bin Sama’at, from Dawood Bin Sirham, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

regarding the woman divorced by Al-Khul’a. Heasws said: ‘Her waiting period is a waiting period of the divorced woman, and she would wait in her house, and the woman divorced by Al-Khul’a is as the status of a woman divorced by Al-Mubaraat’.
en.sarwar: 6. Humayd has narrated from al-Hassan from Ja‘far ibn Sama‘ah from Dawud ibn Sarhan

who has said the following: “About the case of a woman in al-Khul‘ abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Her waiting period is like the waiting period of a divorced woman. She must count her waiting period in her home and a woman of al-Khul‘ is like the woman in al-Mubarat (disavowing).”’
